<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Licenciement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/licenciement">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Licenciement" name="Licenciement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reception" name="Licenciement transmis"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Licenciement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="Process_MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Licenciement" name="Licenciement" sourceRef="Task_Envoyer_Licenciement" targetRef="StartEvent_Reception_Licenciement"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPON" name="Processus MPON" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPON" name="Démarrage">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Envoyer_Licenciement" name="Envoyer le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MPON" name="Licenciement envoyé">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="Task_Envoyer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_2" sourceRef="Task_Envoyer_Licenciement" targetRef="EndEvent_MPON"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="Processus MPOO" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Reception_Licenciement" name="Licenciement reçu">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Reception" messageRef="Message_Licenciement"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Examiner_Licenciement" name="Examiner le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Split" name="Décision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Opposer_Licenciement" name="S'opposer au licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirmer_Licenciement" name="Confirmer le licenciement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Join" name="Fin de décision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MPOO" name="Décision traitée">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Reception_Licenciement" targetRef="Task_Examiner_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_Examiner_Licenciement" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Opposer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Confirmer_Licenciement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_5" sourceRef="Task_Opposer_Licenciement" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_6" sourceRef="Task_Confirmer_Licenciement" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_7" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_MPOO"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Dismissal" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/dismissal">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Dismissal" name="Dismissal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Dismissal">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPON" name="MPON" processRef="Process_MPON"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Dismissal" name="Dismissal" sourceRef="Task_Send_Dismissal" targetRef="StartEvent_Receive_Dismissal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPON" name="MPON process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MPON" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Dismissal" name="Send the dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MPON" name="Dismissal sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPON_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MPON" targetRef="Task_Send_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPON_2" sourceRef="Task_Send_Dismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_MPON"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="MPOO process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Receive_Dismissal" name="Dismissal received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Dismissal" messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review_Dismissal" name="Review the dismissal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Split" name="Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Oppose_Dismissal" name="Oppose the dismissal of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm_Dismissal" name="Confirm the dismissal of MPON">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Opposed" name="Dismissal opposed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPOO_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Receive_Dismissal" targetRef="Task_Review_Dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_Review_Dismissal" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" name="Opposes the dismissal" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Oppose_Dismissal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>MPOO opposes the dismissal</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" name="Confirms the dismissal" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Split" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Dismissal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>MPOO confirms the dismissal</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_5" sourceRef="Task_Oppose_Dismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Opposed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_6" sourceRef="Task_Confirm_Dismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
